body:
Hello Staff Team,

here a few evidence recordings of Hytm using Anti-Knockback. It's very obviously that there was no lag, even if Avicus is the most laggy server of the planet :)

Name of Player being reported: Htym
Rule broken: Rule C) Client Modifications: 1. "Any client modifications that give you a severe, game altering advantage over other Minecraft players is not allowed."

Anything else you would like to add? Pls ban the kiddo

Greetings and have a nice day/night/afternoon/dawn/morning/whatever,
Atdit
